texture.value: Rolling texture is weak. At 90% reduction the α-fiber texture monotonously increased up to 90% rolling reduction; weak orientations near γ-fiber appear at 90% reduction (slightly strengthened, relatively significant at the {111}〈110〉 E position). The α-fiber Brass {110}〈112〉 component increased and scattered to Goss, with the maximum intensity position shifting from φ1 = 45° to 20° at reductions >50%. A weak {552}〈115〉 CuT component detected at 70% spreads to lower Φ after 90%. The β-fiber Goss orientation monotonously increased, with a continuous shift from B towards Goss; along the β-fiber the 90% curve rises above f(g) = 7.0 near φ2 ≈ 85–90°, and the 90% ODF sections contain level 8–9 cores. Overall the texture transitions from 'copper-type' to 'brass-type' at 50% rolling reduction.

overall_structure.value: After 90% cold rolling the microstructure is dominated by abundant shear bands; grains are visibly elongated along the rolling direction (RD) and the matrix is almost entirely consumed by dark shear bands. At the highest strain, dislocation tangles and a dislocation cell structure also develop. The deformation substructure evolution during cold rolling approximately follows the sequence: Taylor lattice → microbands → twins → shear bands → dislocation tangles.

unmapped_findings: The stacking fault energy (SFE) of the Fe–30Mn–11Al–1.2C steel was estimated as ~108 mJ/m² and the Burgers vector of a partial dislocation as 0.146 nm.

The maximum resolved shear stress during cold rolling was ~0.75 GPa, well below the calculated twinning critical stress (~1.48 GPa); twinning nonetheless occurred, attributed to short-range order (SRO) in the austenitic matrix and local stress concentration.

For the 90% rolled sample, Fig. 1(a)/1(b) show the engineering and true stress-strain curves reaching near the 2100 MPa axis limit at very low strain before early fracture (individual numeric stress/strain values are not tabulated for the 90% condition).

Fig. 6(c) is captioned as the bright-field image of dislocation tangles of 90% cold rolling reduction; the manuscript sentence associating the 0.49 μm dislocation tangle structure with this figure sits within the 70% reduction paragraph, creating minor ambiguity in attribution.
